resources.string: Show the centre screen on the cluster (experimental)

The cluster shows the same CarPlay picture as the centre screen, including the following view and lanes in Amap. Whatever is on the centre screen also appears on the cluster. This uses one additional video decoder. To keep 60 fps, the centre-screen resolution is capped at 75% while enabled; reconnect to apply.
Cluster mirroring is on: the actual resolution is capped at 75% to maintain 60 fps.
When navigation is inactive, restore the car\'s instrument display and stop decoding to save performance.
Remove the CarPlay icon bar at the edge of the centre screen.
